name: ThoughtMetric
description: ThoughtMetric is for e-commerce marketing teams that want clear, reliable attribution data across every channel. It works with Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, and custom stores, then ties each order's revenue to the channel, campaign, and ad that drove it. Choose from five attribution models, including first touch, last touch, linear, position based, and multi-touch, and set a lookback window that matches your buying cycle. Connect your ThoughtMetric account to Claude and ask for any metric you would normally check the app to see.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ThoughtMetric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ThoughtMetric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://thoughtmetric.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ThoughtMetric MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ThoughtMetric provides these MCP tools: get_metric_dimension_map, list_available_dimensions, list_available_metrics, list_projects, order_list, and query_metrics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ThoughtMetric?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ThoughtMetric in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
ThoughtMetric requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ThoughtMetric is developed by ThoughtMetric Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
